name: Craftsman CMCCSP20M1
blurb: Pole saw. Oregon prints one chain under CMCCSP20M1: 8″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .043″ gauge, 34 drive links (R34).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Craftsman CMCCSP20M1 under Pole saw with chain R34: 8″ bar, 34 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. R34 is the .043″ low-profile retail code, not an S-series .050″ loop. The guide does not print a file size. The model string is the one Oregon prints. This page does not add a voltage.

bars.note: Oregon prints R34 under Craftsman pole saw CMCCSP20M1: 8″ bar, 34 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
